records.title: EvoGraph-Mem: Failure-Aware Editable Graph Memory for Long-Term Language Agents
records.reason: EvoGraph-Mem addresses long-term language-agent memory quality and failure-aware editing, with no inference resource or serving-efficiency result in the abstract.

records.title: The Fleet Is the Model: Engineering Collective Intelligence with Fusion-MoA Pioneer R1
records.reason: Fusion-MoA is a governed heterogeneous-model service focused on collective capability, authority, and safe promotion/rollback; the abstract reports no inference efficiency improvement.

records.title: A model-based neural network enhancement for micro-cracks informed damage modeling in brittle solids
records.reason: The publisher abstract studies micro-crack-informed constitutive surrogates and brittle-material damage simulations; despite computational efficiency claims, it is unrelated to LLM inference.

records.title: Design of a Materials Testing 2.0 Creep Test Using the Virtual Fields Method and Open Source Tools
records.reason: The paper designs a materials creep-test specimen and inverse-identification GPU workflow, outside LLM inference scope.

records.title: Deep conservation of head direction circuits in bees, ants and flies
records.reason: The study compares insect neural circuit evolution and computational ring-attractor models, outside LLM inference scope.
